purpose: Inventory the provenance and ambiguity boundaries required before a DecisionEligibility policy selector/as-of resolver can become runtime authority.

unresolved_selection_semantics.blocker: CandidateDecisionV1 has no program/policy anchor and current B-09j context_snapshot_ref is null.
unresolved_selection_semantics.forbidden_shortcut: Do not infer program anchor from field_id/season_id or legacy recommendation.program_id.
unresolved_selection_semantics.recommendation: Bind a canonical ContextSnapshot (or equivalent explicit canonical anchor input) and require exactly one declared FieldProgram/equivalent anchor.

unresolved_selection_semantics.blocker: EvidenceScopeV1 allows nullable field/season/zone but defines no wildcard or parent-scope semantics.
unresolved_selection_semantics.forbidden_shortcut: Do not interpret null as wildcard and do not rank more-specific scopes.
unresolved_selection_semantics.recommendation: Authorize explicit scope applicability semantics before selector runtime.

unresolved_selection_semantics.forbidden_shortcut: Do not silently substitute evaluated_at, created_at, wall clock, or latest data time.
unresolved_selection_semantics.recommendation: Require an explicit causal policy-selection boundary or a separately authorized fallback rule.

unresolved_selection_semantics.blocker: B07e consumes one policy and current declaration model allows multiple policy_ids/versions with overlapping scope/action/time.
unresolved_selection_semantics.forbidden_shortcut: No latest version, newest declaration, lexical policy_id, or specificity precedence.
unresolved_selection_semantics.recommendation: Fail closed on >1 applicable declaration unless explicit composition/precedence semantics are authorized.

unresolved_selection_semantics.blocker: supersedes_policy_ref is a pointer only; current contract does not define predecessor termination, chain validity, cycle rules, same-scope requirement, or overlap handling.
unresolved_selection_semantics.forbidden_shortcut: Do not let a supersedes pointer automatically deactivate another policy.
unresolved_selection_semantics.recommendation: Authorize explicit append-only supersession semantics and validate predecessor/chain constraints.

unresolved_selection_semantics.blocker: Contract validates ordering but not selector inclusion/exclusion semantics at effective_until.
unresolved_selection_semantics.forbidden_shortcut: Do not choose inclusive/exclusive end boundary implicitly.
unresolved_selection_semantics.recommendation: Prefer half-open [effective_from,effective_until) only after product-governance authorization.

unresolved_selection_semantics.blocker: Selection must distinguish policy effective time from when declaration became available to runtime.
unresolved_selection_semantics.forbidden_shortcut: Do not select a fact inserted after the decision boundary even if payload dates would otherwise match.
unresolved_selection_semantics.recommendation: As-of selector should require declared_at and persisted occurred_at to be at-or-before the authorized decision boundary.

already_stable_non_decisions.basis: B07e assertPolicyActionApplicability already performs exact membership; no alias mapping is introduced.
B07e accepts one policy object; composition would be a new authority model.
Program lifecycle/context is distinct from policy identity selection and from Approval/Execution.
B06c projects scope/action/basis but does not promote program_id into CandidateDecisionV1.

next_product_governance_decisions: Authorize the canonical policy scope-anchor source, preferably ContextSnapshot DECLARED_FIELD_PROGRAM/equivalent rather than legacy recommendation.program_id.
Authorize policy-selection time semantics when candidate.decision_time is null.
Authorize multiple-policy precedence or explicit fail-closed behavior.
Authorize supersession and effective-window boundary semantics.
Separately authorize real policy content before any B07e connection.
